scanner.coverage: All five source-file top-level declarations, class/interface members, method parameters, local variable/parameter bindings and actual validator Neurou domain literals; excludes imports and property-use identifiers.

classification.P3FrozenSchemaReification: 54 approved P3 data schema names copied into type-only contracts; no new wire schema or semantic renaming.
classification.C1CodecHelperType: Four implementation type helpers, not incoming wire payloads.
classification.C1FrozenPublicClass: Existing approved class names retained; SharedSchemaError is an exported codec-boundary error class.
classification.C1LocalValidationApiType: Caller-installed crypto/trust context, verification result and per-validator-instance WeakSet capabilities; serialization grants no validator capability.
classification.C1LocalReplayApiType: Local replay input/result/diagnostic/provisional projection; SharedProvisionalCoverageEntry and SharedReplayResult provisionalCoverage are not wire checkpoint coverage.
classification.ImplementationInternal: Module-private implementation names, scoped parameters and bindings; no new protocol constants exported.

c1Boundaries.wire: P3 54 types and exact schema 1 wire values remain authoritative; local API names do not extend service receipt purpose or wire enums.
c1Boundaries.capability: ValidatedShared* / TrustedVerifiedGenesis are owned by one validator WeakSet. Reducer stores TrustedCheckpoint in a private Map keyed by digest and requires exact canonical content plus locally owned seal/closure capabilities. An equal copy of a checkpoint already produced by that reducer instance is usable; an unknown checkpoint or a new reducer instance cannot inherit trust from file-supplied hash.
c1Boundaries.cryptography: Actual validator domains only are inventoried. c-1 verifies shared commit envelope/receipts/membership facts; it does not implement WorldRelayKeyPackage cryptographic verification, ECDH key distribution, acceptance, secret storage, Auth calls or HTTP routes.
c1Boundaries.provisional: SharedProvisionalCoverageEntry has finalDiagnostic:null. SharedReplayResult.state includes the provisional tail; checkpoint.state alone represents the settled prefix.
c1Boundaries.constants: BASE64_URL_ALPHABET, CANONICAL_DEPTH_LIMIT and UINT128_MAX are private implementation constants; CANONICAL_DEPTH_LIMIT=128 is a parser safety bound, not a new wire format version or server policy.
c1Boundaries.renaming: SharedCanonicalBytes / SharedCommitCodec / SharedCommitValidator / SharedWorldReducer names remain unchanged.
